body:
Refs #29 (FA-028). Closure is a separate step; the GitHub issue stays OPEN.
**Stacked on #59 (FA-027) → #56 (FA-024)**; the base is `fix/fa-027-seam-view` so the diff shows only this change. Retarget once the base merges.

## Problem
The upstream seam check compared enum `tag:name` only, so a proto money-field type change and an RPC rename kept HIGH/OK; Dart response `errorCode` `String?`/`int?` and null-serialization differences were outside its scope; and proto copies with different packages, options, services and responses were described as identical. A narrow check's OK was read as whole-contract compatibility.

## Change (bounded)
- `domain/seams.py`: `CHECK_SCOPES` (member names/types/tags, envelope, rpc, response types, error mapping, storage, execution, human scenario). Observations declare `covered_scopes` (validated; derived from the members' own fields when an extractor did not declare; UNKNOWN covers nothing). Policies take `required_scopes` (default `member_names`). `scope_coverage()` reports, per required scope, whether both sides covered it **and** the policy compared it — `checked` vs `unverified` with `complete`. `compare()` results carry `scope_coverage`, `copy` (`same_blob` byte identity) and `equivalent_on_checked_scopes`; OK speaks only for the checked scopes.
- `adapters/seam_extraction.py`: the Python enum extractor declares `[member_names, member_types, member_tags]`.
- `domain/seam_view.py`: every observation is a node (those no comparison names are `undeclared: True`); edges carry `scope_coverage` and `copy`; `live` requires OK between two HIGH observations **on every required scope**; the gate treats a scope-incomplete OK as `OK_unverified_scopes` (undecided, never pass); `shared_values` link contracts by `type:tag` identity only, with the note that a shared literal is a coincidence of declarations, never causal delivery.
- `docs/contracts.md`: INV-SEAM-SCOPE-001. Record: `docs/zeus/implementation/seam-scope-001/` (README + receipt with negative controls).

## Verification
- `tests/test_seam_scope.py` (5 tests): policy/observation scope validation; the same two enums are a complete OK under the default policy but leave `response_types` and `rpc` unverified (`complete: False`) when the spec requires them; a names-only policy cannot claim `member_types`; an UNKNOWN peer checks nothing and is BLOCKED; same blob + same members vs different blob + same members vs same blob claimed + different types are three distinct outcomes; in the view an OK under an rpc-requiring spec is not live and leaves the gate undecided, a fully covered OK is live and passes, an uncompared observation stays as an undeclared node, and `HEARTBEAT` shared across two contracts is linked as `str:HEARTBEAT`; the extractor declares its scopes and an unsupported stack covers none.
- With `test_seam_view.py` and `test_seam_contracts.py`: 18 passed. Negative controls: unverified scopes counted as checked → 2 fail; scope-incomplete OK live and passing → 1 fails; shared values keyed by tag only → 1 fails.
- Windows full suite on FA-027 `9ad77e3`: 966 passed, 312 skipped. `ruff check` clean.

## Not claimed
No extractor or checker yet covers envelope, rpc, response types, error mapping, storage, execution or human scenarios — this change makes those scopes honestly unverified when a spec requires them; proto/Dart parsers and runtime checks are separate work. Human-defined error/money scenarios and Astra→Sol→Terra qualification are not consumers of these results.

reviews.body:
# PR #60: 변경 요청 / 병합 보류

검토 head: `a321c70b0d04ac7f65ca591e7bd2ad19386c57e1`. Codex 독립 검토입니다.

**[P2] 선행 seam 추출·view 결함이 수정되지 않은 상태입니다**

required scopes와 byte identity 분리는 유용하지만 #56의 AnnAssign 누락/HIGH 반례가 이 head에서도 재현됩니다. #59의 전체 과거 관측 혼합 경로도 상속합니다. 따라서 complete scope가 실제 누락을 검증한 것으로 해석될 수 있습니다.

위치: [src/codex_harness/adapters/seam_extraction.py:66](https://github.com/trevi00/zeus/blob/a321c70b0d04ac7f65ca591e7bd2ad19386c57e1/src/codex_harness/adapters/seam_extraction.py#L66)

수정·재검증 조건: 선행 #56/#59 수정본에 rebase한 뒤 멤버 분모와 두 revision view 시나리오를 포함해 scope gate를 재검증하세요. 이 PR만 먼저 병합하지 않습니다.

검증: 해당 head의 대상 검사 **9 passed in 1.05s**, Ruff 통과. 개별 대상 검사에 PostgreSQL 통합을 활성화했습니다. 통과 횟수는 파일 간 중복을 포함하므로 고유 테스트 수로 합산하지 않습니다.

실제 모델·사람 인수·실기기·재부팅 검증은 수행하지 않았습니다. PR 수용과 연결 이슈의 완료/종료는 별도입니다.
